relations.subject: search:index-name-uniqueness
relations.reused_or_minted_predicate: reused (availableSince) - same relation logged on cloud/search/create-search-indexes.json in this batch, new evidence from this page
relations.evidence: For Couchbase Server version 7.6 and later, your index name must be unique inside your selected bucket and scope. You cannot have 2 indexes with the same name inside the same bucket and scope.

notable_absence.finding: This page's Prerequisites section lists no role, privilege, or credential-type requirement to create a Search index - only 'Search Service enabled on a node', 'a bucket with scopes and collections', and 'logged in to the Couchbase Capella UI'. This is a notable contrast against: (1) the server/ counterpart of this exact page (server/search/create-search-index-ui.json), which explicitly requires the 'Search Admin' role ('Your user account has the Search Admin role for the bucket where you want to create the index.'); and (2) this same batch's cloud/vector-index/ pages (composite-vector-index.md, hyperscale-vector-index.md), which explicitly require one of Organization Owner / Project Owner / Data Writer Capella management-plane roles via requiresCapellaRole. Cannot tell from the text alone whether Capella's Search Service genuinely dropped this role gate or it is simply undocumented here.

cross_product_finding: See the fuller cross_product_finding logged in cloud/search/create-search-indexes.json (this batch) for the recurring pattern across all three Capella search/ pages processed in this batch: none document an RBAC/role requirement for Search index management, in contrast to this batch's vector-index/ pages which do.
